newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex rallies on Valenciana loan news.
newsitem.headline: Cemex rallies on Valenciana loan news.

text.p: Mexico-based cement maker Cemex S.A was a big winner in early trade on the Mexican bourse on Wednesday, boosted by the announcement of a syndicated loan for its Spanish subsidiary Valenciana de Cementos.
Three series of Cemex shares were among the top ten percentage gainers. Cemex B, A and CPO series were up 2.96 percent, 2.88 percent and 2.52 percent, respectively.
"This is great news, Cemex is a good company. Dealing in the stock is heavy, it's in demand," said a floor trader.
"It was already cheap and foreign bargain hunters have stepped in to buy the stock," he added.
Cemex announced that Valenciana had obtained a syndicated multiple currency loan worth approximately $850 million.
Analysts' reaction to the deal was more lukewarm, however.
"It's good news but it just improves Cemex repayment schedule. It's more of the same," said Jaime Fernandez, an analyst at the Interacciones brokerage.
"The fact that Cemex is rallying is due to it being a blue chip stock and in the current situation, dealers are buying what they are familiar with," he added.
Analysts said that debt was one of Cemex's main stumbling blocks, although the company itself was considered one of the best in its sector and with favorable growth prospects.
